items.name: Copper
items.flavour: Green-skinned copper, dug from a seam deep in the tip's packed layers.

items.name: Iron Ore
items.flavour: Red-brown ore that stains the hands and the Scrapyards alike.

items.name: Coal
items.flavour: Black lumps for the forge, sold by the scuttle and weighed twice.

items.name: Garnet
items.flavour: A dark red stone, dug from a seam where the tip has pressed hardest.

items.name: Brass Ingot
items.flavour: A yellow bar of brass, the same stuff as a Crown and rather heavier.

items.name: Iron Ingot
items.flavour: Plain grey iron, honest until the rain gets at it.

items.name: Steel Ingot
items.flavour: Iron that has been through the fire twice and kept its temper.

items.name: Steel Blade
items.flavour: A plain forged blade, edged on the wheel and sharper than it looks.

items.name: Brass Spanner
items.flavour: Fits most nuts on Sprocket Row, and most rat skulls.

items.name: Brass Key
items.flavour: A brass blank, waiting to be filed to somebody's lock.

items.name: Iron Lock
items.flavour: A stout iron padlock whose key turns twice before it gives.

items.name: Garnet Sight
items.flavour: A rifle sight with a garnet bead that catches the faintest light.

items.name: Rat Scrap
items.flavour: Bent tin, stripped bolts and wire, prised from a Rust Rat and sold by the sackful.

items.name: Scrapjaw's Cleaver
items.flavour: Riveted from three centuries of rubbish and sharpened on girders.

items.name: Ledger Page 1
items.flavour: A page of Hester's, in her own hand.

items.name: Ledger Page, Rustmoor Drop 1
items.flavour: A page of Hester's, in her own hand.

items.name: Ledger Page, Rustmoor Drop 2
items.flavour: A page of Hester's, in her own hand.

items.name: Ledger Page, Rustmoor Drop 3
items.flavour: A page of Hester's, in her own hand.

items.name: Ledger Page, Rustmoor Drop 4
items.flavour: A page of Hester's, in her own hand.

items.name: Iron Rifle
items.flavour: Bench-built from iron and patience, it throws a ball true at thirty yards.

items.name: Spark Rod
items.flavour: An iron rod wound in copper that snaps a blue spark at anything that squeaks.

items.name: Garnet Rifle
items.flavour: An Iron Rifle with a Garnet Sight fitted, for shots you would rather not take twice.

items.name: Brass Slingshot
items.flavour: A brass fork and a strip of boiler gasket that sends a nut wherever you were looking.

items.name: Copper Coil
items.flavour: A hand coil of bare copper wire that stings whatever you point it at.

items.name: Iron Crowbar
items.flavour: Opens crates, doors and Rust Rats with equal disregard.

items.name: Brass Sparker
items.flavour: A brass flint-wheel in a wire cage that spits a crackle the length of your arm.

items.name: Riveting Hammer
items.flavour: A boilermaker's steel hammer, built to close a red-hot rivet in a single blow.

items.name: Steel Carbine
items.flavour: A short steel rifle that puts a slug through a soup tin and the rat inside it.

items.name: Garnet Rod
items.flavour: A Spark Rod tipped with a garnet, which fattens its spark to a fistful.

items.name: Barley Meal
items.flavour: Coarse barley meal in a paper sack, floor sweepings included at no extra charge.

items.name: Salt Pork
items.flavour: Pork packed in so much salt that it will keep longer than you will.

items.name: Rustmoor Ration
items.flavour: A wax-paper brick of whatever went into the pot, stewed until it stopped mattering.

items.name: Bent Nails
items.flavour: A tin of bent nails picked off the tip's loose top, sold by weight to men who straighten them.

items.name: Umbrella Ribs
items.flavour: Steel umbrella ribs from the loose top of the tip, the silk long since gone to the rats.

items.name: Odd Spoons
items.flavour: Silver spoons thrown off Gaugehill, each one crested and no two of them a pair.

items.name: Clock Movement
items.flavour: A clock's brass works, thrown off Gaugehill for losing two minutes a week.

items.name: Foundry Pass
items.flavour: Leave to pass the Cinderworks gate, made out to you and nobody else.

items.name: Board Memo
items.flavour: A Board of Gauges memo on cream paper, chewed at one corner by a rat with opinions about stationery.

items.name: Cracked Gauge Glass
items.flavour: A gauge face thrown off Gaugehill, its glass cracked and its needle stuck at reassuring.

items.name: Ballast Day Ribbon
items.flavour: A commemorative ribbon from the last Ballast Day, kept in a Lowvents drawer by someone who did not attend.

items.name: Misstruck Crown
items.flavour: A Crown stamped with its needle pointing down, which no clerk at the window will take.

items.name: Brass Breastplate
items.flavour: A brass breastplate hammered from a single ingot, thin enough to hear a rat's teeth on it.

items.name: Iron Cuirass
items.flavour: Front and back plates of grey iron, buckled at the sides and heavier on the stairs.

items.name: Steel Cuirass
items.flavour: A steel cuirass, blued in the quench, that turns a Tinplate's teeth without comment.

items.name: Ribbed Cuirass
items.flavour: A steel cuirass stiffened inside with umbrella ribs from the tip, and still no use in the rain.

items.name: Brass Buckler
items.flavour: A brass buckler the size of a saucepan lid, and about as respected.

items.name: Iron Targe
items.flavour: A round iron targe with a forearm strap and a dent already in it, free of charge.

items.name: Steel Shield
items.flavour: A riveted steel shield that rings like a dinner bell whenever a rat finds it.

items.name: Garnet-Boss Shield
items.flavour: A steel shield with a garnet in its boss, which a rat stares at one heartbeat too long.

items.name: Brass Plumb Bob
items.flavour: A brass plumb bob on a cord, for a Tinker who likes to know which way is down.

items.name: Iron Dividers
items.flavour: A pair of iron dividers that walk off every distance twice and trust neither answer.

items.name: Steel Vernier
items.flavour: A steel vernier scale, read to the hundredth of an inch by anyone with the patience.

items.name: Garnet Pendulum
items.flavour: A clock's pendulum with a garnet for its bob, swinging steadier than the hand that holds it.

items.name: Brass Skullcap
items.flavour: A brass skullcap beaten round on a bollard, close enough to a hat in poor light.

items.name: Iron Pot Helm
items.flavour: An iron pot helm that could pass for a cooking pot, and has.

items.name: Steel Sallet
items.flavour: A steel sallet with a long tail at the back for whatever falls off the crane.

items.name: Visored Sallet
items.flavour: A steel sallet whose visor is beaten from Gaugehill's odd spoons, crests still showing.

items.name: Brass Knuckle-Guards
items.flavour: Brass plates strapped over the knuckles, for the hand that does the arguing.

items.name: Iron Gauntlets
items.flavour: Iron gauntlets with jointed fingers that pinch only for the first week.

items.name: Steel Gauntlets
items.flavour: Steel gauntlets fine enough in the fingers to turn a key in the dark.

items.name: Geared Gauntlets
items.flavour: Steel gauntlets with a clock's brass works in the knuckles, so the grip closes tooth by tooth.

items.name: Brass Toecaps
items.flavour: Brass caps riveted over the toes of your own boots, for kicking things that bite.

items.name: Iron Sabatons
items.flavour: Iron foot-plates that strap over a boot and announce you three yards ahead.

items.name: Steel Sabatons
items.flavour: Jointed steel sabatons that keep their shape when the tip shifts underfoot.

items.name: Hobnailed Sabatons
items.flavour: Steel sabatons soled with the tip's own bent nails, straightened once and driven in head-out.

items.name: Brass Pick
items.flavour: A brass pick too soft for real rock, which is fine, since Rustmoor's seams are mostly old saucepans.

items.name: Iron Pick
items.flavour: An iron pick of the kind every picker at the tip swears by, and at.

items.name: Steel Pick
items.flavour: A tempered steel pick that bites into the packed layers instead of bouncing off them.

items.name: Garnet-Tipped Pick
items.flavour: A steel pick with crushed garnet fused to its point, which grinds where plain steel would skid.

items.name: Brass Tongs
items.flavour: Brass forge tongs that warm up faster than you would like.

items.name: Iron Tongs
items.flavour: Iron tongs with long reins, so the hot end and your hand stay on speaking terms.

items.name: Steel Tongs
items.flavour: Steel tongs with jaws ground to an ingot's width, which never drop the same one twice.

items.name: Spring Tongs
items.flavour: Steel tongs sprung open by an umbrella rib, so they let go the moment you do.

items.name: Brass Driver Roll
items.flavour: A roll of brass drivers, soft enough to strip a screw and honest enough to bend first.

items.name: Iron Driver Roll
items.flavour: Iron drivers and a feeler gauge in a roll, each with its own pocket and none in it.

items.name: Steel Driver Roll
items.flavour: Hardened steel drivers and a set of gauges, ground to fit the Polytechnic's screws.

items.name: Watchmaker's Roll
items.flavour: Drivers no thicker than a pin, filed from a clock's own arbors, for work done holding your breath.

items.name: Brass Ladle
items.flavour: A brass ladle hammered deep enough to serve one Ration a scoop.

items.name: Iron Ladle
items.flavour: An iron ladle with a hooked handle that hangs on the pot's rim and stays out of the stew.

items.name: Steel Ladle
items.flavour: A steel ladle with a pouring lip, so the stew goes in the tin and not on the bench.

items.name: Crested Ladle
items.flavour: A steel ladle with a crested Gaugehill spoon riveted on for a lip, so supper comes in somebody's family silver.

items.name: Brass Salvage Hook
items.flavour: A brass hook on a broom handle, for lifting things off the tip that you would rather not touch.

items.name: Iron Salvage Hook
items.flavour: An iron hook with a barb filed into it, so what it lifts stays lifted.

items.name: Steel Salvage Hook
items.flavour: A long steel hook that reaches under the loose top without the loose top reaching back.

items.name: Clockwork Grapnel
items.flavour: A steel grapnel sprung by a clock's works, which snaps shut on whatever it touches first.
